assay: bulk RNA-seq, M. quadriceps, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, STAR + salmon, TPM matrix (S2.8.p1)
organism: Mouse, male C57BL/6 WT, 22-26 weeks at sacrifice (S2.1.p1)
groups: 7 groups x n=3: sedentary; untrained 0h/6h/72h; trained 0h/6h/72h (S2.3.p1, GEO treatment column)
primary_estimand: Bulk-muscle gene expression change in each exercised condition (untrained or trained, 0h/6h/72h after an exhaustive treadmill bout) versus sedentary baseline
planned_contrasts: untrained 0h vs sedentary (FIG4 A; count shown only in figure, myonuclear subset)
inclusion: all 21 samples; DEG counts in FIG4 A restricted to the ATAC-derived myonuclear gene subset (23% of genes, S3.4.p1), which needs GSE302910 peak calls and is not reproduced
paper_method: DESeq2 (GEO data_processing: Differential expression analysis was performed with DESeq2 v3.16); input stated as salmon TPM collected into a count matrix (S2.8.p1)
paper_results: 1,848 myonuclear-subset genes up/down in >=1 condition (S3.4.p1); more up/down at 0h trained vs untrained, similar up at 6h, more down in trained at 6h, very few changes at 72h (S3.4.p1); Klf5 and Esrrg show training-state-dependent expression (S3.4.p1, FIG4 C)
